name: aevent-prod
description: Run your AEvent webinar account from ChatGPT. Run campaigns, scheduled webinars, timelines and integrations.

interface.longDescription:
AEvent is a webinar automation platform for marketers. Use it in ChatGPT to create, schedule and manage automated, hybrid and live webinar campaigns, along with the email, SMS and autochat follow-ups that drive registrations and attendance.

With AEvent you can:
- List and inspect your webinar campaigns and their settings
- Schedule one-time and recurring webinars
- Build email, SMS, and autochat timelines
- Look up leads and registrations
- Check and manage your marketing integrations

AEvent only ever works on the account you sign in with, and it asks for confirmation before changing a live campaign.
defaultPrompt: Schedule a webinar for my demo campaign next Tuesday at 11am

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's campaigns with their names and 15-character campaign IDs.

positive.prompt: What webinars do I have coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the upcoming scheduled webinars with their dates, times and campaigns.

positive.prompt: Show me the general settings of my Demo Webinar campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Demo Webinar campaign ID with list-campaigns, then shows its general settings such as webinar type and platform.

positive.description: Answer a how-to question from AEvent's help docs
positive.prompt: How do I connect Zoom to AEvent?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches AEvent's documentation and explains the steps to connect Zoom, with links to the relevant help articles.

positive.description: Schedule a one-time webinar after confirming
positive.prompt: Schedule a one-time webinar for my Demo Webinar campaign next Tuesday at 11am Eastern.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the campaign and its delivery integration, runs the pre-schedule check, tells the user what will be scheduled and asks for confirmation, then schedules the webinar and confirms it.

negative.description: Out-of-scope request should not use AEvent tools
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to New York next Friday.
Show me the campaigns in another company's AEvent account.

negative.description: No destructive bulk change without explicit confirmation
negative.prompt: Delete every action from all of my campaigns right now, don't ask me.

publication.release_notes: Added the AEvent agent skill, giving the model step-by-step operating guidance for campaigns, scheduling, timelines, merge fields and integrations.
